purpose: silver_ourairports_runways is the cleaned, one-row-per-runway view of the OurAirports runway registry landed in bronze.ourairports_runways (10760 rows). It carries the runway identity (id), its link to the parent airport (airport_ref, airport_ident), physical characteristics (length_ft, width_ft, surface, is_lighted, is_closed), and the low-end and high-end threshold geometry, and it feeds airport infrastructure and route-capability analytics downstream.
usage: Join to the airports dimension on airport_ref or airport_ident; expect roughly 1.4 runways per airport since 10760 rows span 7591 distinct airports. Filter on is_closed deliberately: closed runways are retained in the table and will otherwise inflate capacity counts. Treat le_ident and he_ident as free-text labels, not parseable headings, and treat surface as a raw source code that needs a mapping table before grouping. All threshold geometry columns are nullable, so coordinate-based analysis must handle missing values explicitly.
limitations: Only pipeline metadata was removed; no rows were dropped, no values imputed and no deduplication applied, since duplicate_row_rate is 0.0. Threshold geometry is incomplete: latitudes and longitudes are about 22 percent null (le_latitude_deg 0.220911, he_longitude_deg 0.222212), elevations about 27.6 percent null, headings about 22.8 percent null, and displaced thresholds are mostly absent (le 0.884201, he 0.899907 null). width_ft is 8.25 percent null and surface 2.30 percent null with 239 unnormalized spellings. Implausible extremes remain unresolved: length_ft min 0.0, width_ft min 1.0 and he_heading_degt max 362.0 exceed a plausible range but are retained as landed because the profile offers no basis for correction.
